basis: states of 50 returning data in 2024; DC excluded per D-006
note: A constituent has to register in enough of the fifty states to be placed on a common scale with the others; the threshold is 20. One that registers in too few is set to zero in every state, so it adds nothing anywhere. Every state is lowered by the same amount, which means no state moves in rank and no state moves relative to the median state. The count is a fact about the measure, assessed once when the universe was locked, and it is not a figure that changes a reading. It is not an index and is never drawn on an index axis.
below_note: One constituent sits below the threshold and is kept in the universe anyway, as a documented exception: it is the only alternative name for its school level, and dropping it would leave that level described by fewer ways of naming it than the others.
